summary.headline: Planetary Configurations and Their Effects
summary.text: Discussion of planetary co-presences and configurations involving Saturn, Jupiter, the Sun, and Moon, including their effects on acquisitions, friendships, foreign affairs, land, offices, gifts, dangers, and judgments. Editorial notes compare Marcianus 314 and Marcianus 324 and cite excerpts from codex 6.
